tolerance.criterion: relative difference from the four-code mean within 1%
tolerance.source: AAPM Report 195: users are asked to report the relative percentage difference against the mean (p.56), and the reference values themselves carry up to 1% statistical uncertainty per VOI (section 3.4).
tolerance.note: The inter-code range is reported separately and is a stricter bar than the report asks for -- for some VOIs the four packages agree to 0.1%, tighter than their own stated statistics.

known_gaps: MC-GPU tallies collision kerma; electrons are not transported.
Phantom modelled at 40 cm rather than the specified 300 cm; run --length-scan to show this is converged.
Voxelised cylinder: the curved surface is stair-stepped at the 0.25 cm voxel scale.
The fan is approximated by 4 azimuthal sub-fans; the residual solid-angle error is +0.0674 %.
Only 30 cm of the 44 cm source-to-phantom air path is inside the voxel box; MC-GPU crosses the remainder without interaction. Measured sensitivity: see results/phase1a_G1_air_margin_convergence.json.
